name: Introduction to Public Policy and STI
description: Relationship between the state, market and citizens, naming and framing of issues, policy agenda, advocacy, policy-making process, policy typologies and mechanisms, rational choice and its critiques, complexity and bounded rationality, wicked problems, public goods and common pool resources, multi-level governance, institutions and institutional analysis, theories of justice, neoliberalism and new public management, global south and north.
